title: FloofyCrew patch descriptor (kind: patch, schema 1)
description: An overlay patch applied by the Patcher (Requirement 5) to one file of a host payload. Every text op is gated by a content fingerprint that must match exactly once and by the 'appliesTo' host-version range (Requirement 5.5); 'marker' makes an op idempotent. Patches on hashed chunks are swapped in through the host's inline import map (design spike 1.4), which is why a descriptor may carry an 'importMap' block.

target.description: Path of the file to patch, relative to the payload root (for example kiro_crew/static/dist/index.html). Host Python sources and launcher files are refused as engineering-rule targets (Requirement 5.10); governance files are allowed but flagged governance-altering (Requirement 11.4).

appliesTo.description: Host base-version range (X.Y.Z) the patch applies to; outside it the Patcher skips the descriptor with a diagnostic (Requirement 5.5). Default: every version.

fromBuild.description: Optional inclusive lower bound on the full host version (including an internal build number or insider tag) for build-range gating, in the spirit of Vencord's fromBuild.

toBuild.description: Optional exclusive upper bound on the full host version for build-range gating.

cacheBust.description: True when the target is a content-hashed immutable asset that must be republished under a new name (Requirement 5.6). Not needed for the import-map remap path.

importMap.description: Optional import-map keys to add to the host's inline import map in index.html: original specifier or URL -> replacement URL under the Loader app's ui/patched/ path (design spike 1.4). Kept permissive on purpose; the Patcher validates the URLs.

ops.description: Text operations applied in order. A fingerprint that matches zero or several times makes the Patcher SKIP the whole descriptor (never a partial rewrite).

hostVersion.description: A host version as the host prints it: X.Y.Z, X.Y.Z.N, X.Y.ZrcN, X.Y.Z.devN or X.Y.Z-insider.N.

marker.description: A literal that is present in the target once the op has been applied; its presence makes the op a no-op (idempotency).

oneOf.description: insert-before / insert-after / replace: 'fingerprint' must match exactly once (literal, or a regular expression when 'regex' is true).
append-head: 'content' is inserted just before </head>; no fingerprint needed.
